setlist.title: It's All Over Now Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (6 reviews): In the transition jam, each time the band seems ready to settle, Jerry adds another riff that revs things up; Jerry sings the 'headlight' verse twice, making this one of the reviewer's favorite 1980s China>Riders [9][10][11][12][17][18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Second-set China>Rider is among the most devastating; Brent and Phil open with an arcade-game-like intro, Weir plays pretty chordal patterns; Recommends starting at the China-Rider, then Prophet-Eyes, then the closing Wheel, Stones, NFA, Baby Blue run [9][16]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song is described as nicely esoteric [13]
- **Space** (1 review): Drums/space has classic 1984 character, with weird beam-like, arcade and guitar sounds circling around [11]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): A keyboard intro to Throwing Stones leads to a much longer build-up than usual [15]
- **Baby Blue** (1 review): It's All Over Now, Baby Blue closer is singled out as a highlight [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happy Birthday Billy**: rare: 4 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-05-07.sbd.SIRMick.88850.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Small portion missing in the transition from Drums into Space; Phil's bass is loud enough to be risky on headphones [1]
- **gd1984-05-07.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77303.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1984-05-07.152056.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd84-05-07.sbd.lai.350.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 4/5 by 9 [5]. Said about its sound: Garcia's guitar sits a little low in the mix during the first set; Soundboard quality is outstanding; Brent is very prominent, while Jerry sits rather low in the mix [9][11][12][15]
- **gd1984-05-07.set2.senn441.andrewf.105436.flac16**: source not stated; 9 songs; 78 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: This set-two audience recording sounds poor; upgrades are said to exist [19]

## Around the show

- Crowd sings Happy Birthday to Bill Kreutzmann between Loser and Mama Tried [3]
- The show fell on Bill Kreutzmann's 38th birthday, with birthday wishes before Mama Tried [5]
- First set is ordinary for the mid-1980s, while the second set is nice [10]
- Reviewer argues the show proves the Dead could rock in the 1980s, with heavy Brent keyboards and Jerry interplay [16]
- This is the first complete audience source of the show in general circulation, as of June 2020 [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-05-07.sbd.SIRMick.88850.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: sbd >dat [1]
- **gd1984-05-07.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77303.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Transferred/Edited by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) > (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 ->… [2]. Also: Source comes from cassettes by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, with a tape flip between Drums and Space [2]
- **gd1984-05-07.152056.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [3]
- **gd84-05-07.sbd.lai.350.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by DAE and encoding by C. Vinci, Seed via M. Lai; source: SBD> Cass> DAT> cdr [5]. Also: Reviewer has owned a cassette of this show since 1984; Reviewer got a tape of this show from a street seller on E. 8th Street in Greenwich Village [12][17]
- **gd1984-05-07.set2.senn441.andrewf.105436.flac16**: transferred by Andrew F.; source: Sennheiser 441's > patched thru unknown decks > Toshiba KTR2 Walkman. Recorded in the mezzanine. 1st Gen cassette transferred. [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-05-07 Silva Hall, Hult Center, Eugene, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-05-07-silva-hall-hult-center-eugene-or-usa/) [22]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1984-05-07 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1984-05-07-backstage-pass/) [23]
